222-527-969-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-969-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.

833-3756-3827-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
833-3756-3827-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Izzet Boilerworks, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

4222-4289-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

3197-7687-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3197-7687-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.

751-1741-3497-5778.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
751-1741-3497-5778.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries with offspring by paying {1}{U} using the cost reduction from Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries abilities, untapping two lands.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When the token copy of Cloud of Faeries enters, its ability triggers, untapping two lands.
Activate four lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake with offspring by paying {U}, using cost reduction from Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries to its owner's hand.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Shrieking Drake.
When the token copy of Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers, returning the nontoken Shrieking Drake to its owner's hand.
Repeat.
751-1741-3497-5778.notes: Once infinite mana has been generated, the Shrieking Drake can return any creature other than Zinnia to hand to recast infinitely.

5075-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:

You control another nonland creature.

Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

413-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.

During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.

When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1671-5451-5478-5702.description:

Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn.

Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3168-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2511-3168-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2511-3168-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1637-4377-4423-4935.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1637-4377-4423-4935.description:

Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

575-5256-5318.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Forest.
575-5256-5318.description:

When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest land from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Forest's power.
Repeat.

681-1644-1669-4423-4826.notablePrerequisites:

681-1644-1669-4423-4826.description:

Activate Thaumatog's first ability four times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands, giving Thaumatog +4/+4 until end of turn.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Tatyova triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Livio.
Repeat.
